patthana17.1:2.1: dhammaṃ paṭicca no parāmāso dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. Parāmāsaṃ paṭicca sampayuttakā khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañ ca rūpaṃ. 4. No parāmāsaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca no parāmāso dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. No parāmāsaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañ ca rūpaṃ; dve . . . (paṭisandhi, yāva ajjhattikā
patthana17.1:3.1: mahābhūtā). 5. No parāmāsaṃ . . . parāmāso dhammo . . . No parāmāse khandhe paṭicca parāmāso. 6. No parāmāsaṃ . . . parāmāso ca no parāmāso . . . No parāmāsaṃ ekaṃ . . . khandhā parāmāso ca cittasamuṭṭhānañ
patthana17.1:4.1: ca rūpaṃ; dve . . . 8. Parāmāsañ ca no parāmāsañ ca . . . no parāmāso . . . No parāmāsaṃ ekaṃ khandhañ ca parāmāsañ ca paṭicca tayo khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañ ca rūpaṃ; dve . . .
patthana17.1:5.1: Hetuyā pañca, vipāke ekaṃ, ārammaṇe pañca, avigate pañca.
patthana17.1:6.1: sabbattha pañca; 4. No parāmāsaṃ . . . no parāmāso . . . nahetupaccayā. Ahetukaṃ
patthana17.1:7.1: no parāmāsaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo. khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañ ca rūpaṃ; dve . . . (ahetukapaṭisandhi, yāva asaññasattā). Vicikicchāsahagate
patthana17.1:8.1: uddhaccasahagate khandhe paṭicca vicikicchāsahagato uddhaccasahagato moho. 2. Parāmāsaṃ . . . no
patthana17.1:9.1: parāmāso . . . nārammaṇapaccayā. Parāmāsaṃ paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ. 4. No parāmāsaṃ . . . uppajjati nārammaṇapaccayā. No parāmāse khandhe paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ, . . . (yāva asaññasattā). 8. Parāmāsañ ca no parāmāsañ ca . . . Parāmāsañ ca sampayuttake ca khandhe paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ.
patthana17.1:10.1: Nahetuyā ekaṃ, nakamme tīṇi, nārammaṇe tīṇi, navipāke pañca, nadhipatiyā pañca, nāhāre ekaṃ, nānantare tīṇi, na-indriye ekaṃ, nasamanantare tīṇi, najhāne ekaṃ, na-aññamaññe tīṇi, namagge ekaṃ, na-upanissaye tīṇi, nasampayutte tīṇi, napurejāte pañca, navippayutte pañca, napacchājāte pañca, nonatthiyā tīṇi, nāsevane pañca, novigate tīṇi. Hetupaccayā, nārammaṇe nasampayutte nava, tīṇi, navippayutte pañca, nādhipatiyā pañca, nonatthiyā tīṇi, navipāke pañca, novigate tīṇi, Nahetupaccayā, ārammaṇe sabbattha ekaṃ; ekaṃ, avigate ekaṃ. (Sahajātavāro pi paṭiccavārasadiso.) 2. Parāmāsaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā no parāmāso dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. Parāmāsaṃ paccayā sampayuttakā khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañ ca rūpaṃ. 4. No parāmāsaṃ . . . paccayā no parāmāso . . . No parāmāsaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paccayā tayo khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañ ca rūpaṃ; dve . . . (paṭisandhi, yāva ajjhattikā mahābhūtā). Vatthuṃ paccayā no parāmāsā khandhā. 5. No parāmāsaṃ . . . parāmāso . . . hetupaccayā. No parāmāse khandhe paccayā parāmāso; vatthuṃ paccayā parāmāso. 6. No parāmāsaṃ . . . parāmāso ca no . . . No parāmāsaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paccayā tayo khandhā parāmāso ca cittasamuṭṭhānañ ca rūpaṃ; dve . . . Vatthuṃ paccayā parāmāso; mahābhūte paccayā cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ; vatthuṃ . . . sampayuttakā ca khandhā. 8. Parāmāsañ ca no parāmāsañ ca . . . no parāmāso . . . hetupaccayā. No parāmāsaṃ ekaṃ khandhañ ca parāmāsañ ca paccayā tayo khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañ ca rūpaṃ; dve . . . Parāmāsañ ca sampayuttake ca khandhe paccayā cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ. Parāmāsañ ca mahābhūte ca paccayā . . . Parāmāsañ ca vatthuñ ca paccayā no parāmāsā khandhā . . . (saṃkhittaṃ). Hetuyā pañca, sabbattha pañca; ārammaṇe pañca, vipāke ekaṃ, adhipatiyā pañca, avigate pañca. 4. No parāmāsaṃ . . . no parāmāso . . . nahetupaccayā. Ahetukaṃ no parāmāsaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paccayā tayo khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañ ca rūpaṃ; dve . . . (ahetukapaḷisandhi, yāva asaññasattā). Cakkhāyatanaṃ paccayā cakkhuviññāṇaṃ . . . kāyāyatanaṃ paccayā kāyaviññāṇaṃ; vatthuṃ paccayā ahetukā no parāmāsā khandhā. Vicikicchāsahagate uddhaccasahagate khandhe ca vatthuñ ca paccayā vicikicchā-, uddhacca- sahagato moho . . . (saṃkhittaṃ). Nahetuyā ekaṃ, navipāke pañca, nārammaṇe tīṇi, nāhāre ekaṃ, nādhipatiyā pañca, na-indriye ekaṃ, nānantare tīṇi . . . pe . . . najhāne ekaṃ,
patthana17.1:19.1: napurejāte pañca, nasampayutte tīṇi, napacchājāte pañca, navippayutte pañca, nāsevane pañca, nonatthiyā tīṇi, nakamme tīṇi, novigate tīṇi.
